rows.title: A grant needs the user's words and every limit, restated
rows.defect: a grant without the user's words is accepted
rows.test: grant without words or amount is refused; restatement names every limit

rows.title: Offered only after the trust ladder earns it
rows.defect: the ladder's offer is not required for a grant
rows.test: three clean confirmations earn the offer; a correction resets; early grants refused

rows.title: Inside the envelope: no question, a receipt that says so
rows.defect: the receipt no longer says the action ran under an envelope
rows.test: the sweep runs unasked and the receipt names the envelope and how to stop

rows.title: The per-action limit is checked against what is written
rows.defect: the gate trusts the caller's summary amount over the params
rows.test: one cent over asks; a lying summary asks

rows.title: The weekly cap cuts what remains
rows.defect: weekly usage no longer cuts the per-action limit
rows.test: after $100 of $120 a $40 sweep asks and $20 runs

rows.title: A recipient-bound envelope asks for anyone else
rows.defect: the recipient check is removed from the gate

rows.title: A first-time recipient is never inside an envelope
rows.defect: the first-time check is removed from the gate
rows.test: first_time asks under a matching envelope

rows.title: Expiry: an expired envelope asks
rows.defect: expiry is ignored both where envelopes are listed and where the gate picks one
rows.test: day 91 asks; renewal is a new grant

rows.title: Revoke by text, immediately
rows.defect: "stop" replies as if it revoked but changes nothing
rows.test: stop ends it before the next action; revoke all ends every envelope

rows.title: Paused means no envelope
rows.defect: the kill switch gate always allows
rows.test: while paused the action is blocked without asking

rows.title: An envelope never lowers a tier
rows.defect: the tier floor on grants is removed
rows.test: grants for T3/T5 refused; T5 asks even with an envelope

rows.title: Standing instructions do not widen an envelope
rows.defect: a scheduled request skips the per-action limit
rows.test: an instruction over the limit confirms; inside it runs

rows.title: Every envelope action is in the audit
rows.test: the report lists date, amount, reference and what is left

rows.title: A surprise suspends the envelope
rows.defect: a surprise records itself but leaves the envelope active
rows.test: after a surprise the next action asks; resume needs words

rows.title: The thread always knows an envelope is acting
rows.defect: the restatement drops how to stop the envelope
rows.test: the grant restatement says how to stop; receipts say no question was asked; live envelopes are listable
